response.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT ID, AVG(HGB)*1.0/AVG(HCT) AS ratio FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID HAVING AVG(HGB) IS NOT NULL AND AVG(HCT) IS NOT NULL AND AVG(HCT) <> 0), k AS (SELECT ID, ratio, ratio - (SELECT AVG(ratio) FROM r) AS diff1 FROM r WHERE ratio > (SELECT AVG(ratio) FROM r)), f AS (SELECT ID, ratio, diff1, ratio - (SELECT AVG(ratio) FROM k) AS diff2 FROM k WHERE ratio > (SELECT AVG(ratio) FROM k)) SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio, AVG(diff1) AS avg_above_overall, AVG(diff2) AS avg_above_second FROM f
